title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the legacy-organization row filters out of protocol.ts into protocol-legacy-organization-rows.ts (#25467 cut 29)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 29 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–28 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449, #26654, #26704, #26807, #26873, #26933 and #26980. The claim is `6457847737`. It takes the cut 29 proposal of the cut 28 report (`6456729821`), a themed pair. Both members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and both moved unedited.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into one new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-legacy-organization-rows.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the legacy-organization row filters. On a database the ADR-0131 ceremony has not migrated, these find the rows that still belong to one organization rather than to the environment:

- `legacyOrganizationRowsOf`: those rows of one table, read off the physical column through the table's driver. A read inside a transaction joins it.
- `withoutLegacyOrganizationRows`: a row list with those rows left out.

`findEnvironmentRow` stays in the class, as the claim says: a census trial moving it dropped the count 88 → 81 in the cut 28 report. `protocol.ts` grows by 4 net lines (29,384 to 29,388): 9 body lines left, and 11 stub lines plus the 2-line import came in. The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `3271a0834c` (after cut 28's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `0522e4d4ea` and, as the claim asked, one merge of `main`, `ad684a0ce3` (7 commits). That merge touches nothing in `packages/metadata-protocol/`. The merged tree was still measured against `main` (see "The merged tree against `main`").

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

The claim named **#26920** as the open PR that also edits `protocol.ts` and asked for a `git merge-tree` against it before this PR was opened.

- **#26920** (head `380f37a55a`) edits `protocol.ts` at `:16153–16206` and `:20256` (+54 / −17), plus other files of this package. It names neither moved member. This cut's hunks are at `:425` (the import) and `:10212–10225`.
- Its `git merge-tree` against this head `ad684a0ce3` is **clean**.
- That merged tree was type-checked: `git merge-tree` to a tree, then `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` on that tree exits 0. On it, the moved bodies still compare 187 tokens, 0 differ.
- Its merge-tree against `main` alone is clean too.

All 30 open PRs were checked against this head as well. Five touch this package (#26937, #26920, #26831, #26556, #26517), none names either member, and every one is merge-tree clean against this head and against `main`. #26831's earlier conflict with `main` is gone.

`main` has not moved since the merge (0 behind at the derivation).

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut. Both read `89 read seam(s)`, the base the claim quotes, and the lists are identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `withoutLegacyOrganizationRows<R>` | `:10212` | private async, generic | 3 | 102 | `legacyOrganizationRowsOf` (method) |
| `legacyOrganizationRowsOf` | `:10218` | private | 6 | 85 | `engine` (field); module-level `readLegacyOrganizationRows` |

`protocol-legacy-organization-rows.ts` has 74 lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–28 apply it)

- **The class keeps both members.** Each keeps its name, signature and position (neither has a docblock). Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 29]`.
- **`LegacyOrganizationRowsHost`** types the two members the bodies read as the class members themselves (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['engine']` and `['legacyOrganizationRowsOf']`). Each function's `this` is a `Pick` of the members it reads.
- **The `engine` field is handed over as a getter**, so the read finds it at call time, as before.
- **`withoutLegacyOrganizationRows`'s call to `legacyOrganizationRowsOf` is handed over as a closure**, `(...a) => this.legacyOrganizationRowsOf(...a)`, as the claim asked. So that call still reaches the class method (now its stub), not the moved function directly.
- **The generic member is called through an instantiation expression**, `(withoutLegacyOrganizationRows<R>).call(host, table, rows, context)`, as cut 11 did for `materializeFromRegistry<T>`. So the stub still returns `Promise<R[]>`, not `Promise<unknown[]>`.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** None changes:
  - `withoutLegacyOrganizationRows`: `findEnvironmentRows` (`:10185`, base).
  - `legacyOrganizationRowsOf`: `findEnvironmentRows` (`:10190`), `findEnvironmentRow` (`:10206`), `withoutLegacyOrganizationRows` (above) and `:26506`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader: no import leaves `protocol.ts`

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded).

The one module-level name the bodies read is `readLegacyOrganizationRows`, from `@objectstack/metadata-core`. It has two other code readers in `protocol.ts` (`:21892` and `:28524`, base), so it stays, and so does its `[ADR-0131 D6/D7]` import comment. The new module imports it from there too. So the top level of `protocol.ts` changes by the new module's import alone.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut**, including on the merged tree against `main`. The cut adds one import statement and its comment ahead of every class docblock, so the cut 25 comment-offset trap was watched. It did not fire: the raw hash is identical at both ends.

Base `3271a0834c` and head `0522e4d4ea` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `a9338265ddd795ccfd7fda56ee209f3c2e162f9153766351149994f20e92715f` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `7307bcccb6026da6c004fa2daaca634d3419d202d6b742c122a7a3c64a552712` at both ends, 781,687 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `a604e2fd4c5cb76c…` at base and `16b25c206072e2f3…` at head (`index.cjs` `5beb42aa247530b3…` → `7aec221248f758d4…`).
  - `….call(host` goes 0 → 1 for each of the two members in both bundles.
  - Each `function …(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `legacyOrganizationRowsOf` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `38b33a942d07398f…` (normalised `a0c35bd1e1a5b943…`, which differs from the bar's `a9338265…`) and print `legacyOrganizationRowsOf(table: string, context?: unknown): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, string>>;`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. Neither function, and not `LegacyOrganizationRowsHost`, appears.

### The merged tree against `main`

The merged tree `ad684a0ce3` was measured against `main` `7eb613c39f`, its second parent, in the same way. The closure was rebuilt by a full `pnpm build` (116/116), and `main`'s package `src/` was swapped in tree-only and restored under a trap. The merged tree differs from `main` only by this cut: 2 files, +87 / −9.

- **`.d.ts`**: raw `7307bcccb6026da6…` (781,687 bytes) and normalised `a9338265ddd795cc…`, the same at `main` and merged. Both identities hold.
- **`index.js`**: `a604e2fd4c5cb76c…` at `main`, `16b25c206072e2f3…` merged. Export tables: 78 names, `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on both.
- **AST compare**, `main`'s `protocol.ts` against the merged one: 187 tokens, 0 differ.
- **Suite**: `main` and merged both give 21,748 tests (21,722 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped, 279 files), per test identical.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `89 read seam(s)` at both ends, the base the claim quotes. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (165 lines, and no entry changes file).

- Neither body has a `try`. `legacyOrganizationRowsOf` hands its read to `readLegacyOrganizationRows`, and neither body calls the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`).
- No seam enters or leaves the census. `findEnvironmentRows` and `findEnvironmentRow`, the seam members that call these two, stay in the class.
- On the merged tree the list is identical too, `89 read seam(s)`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `3271a0834c` against the head module:

```
withoutLegacyOrganizationRows: base tokens 102, head tokens 102, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
legacyOrganizationRowsOf: base tokens 85, head tokens 85, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=187 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=303 head=303 order-same=true byte-identical=301 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=262 head=263 byte-identical=262
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module, and only the mutated member moved (differ 1; the other stayed 0):

```
"rows.length === 0) return"        -> "rows.length === 1) return"     withoutLegacyOrganizationRows differ 1
"transaction !== undefined ?"      -> "transaction === undefined ?"   legacyOrganizationRowsOf differ 1
```

- **Class side.** There are 303 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 301 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Both stubs sit at their base positions and keep their signatures (and type parameter) byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 262 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +87 / −9 over 2 files, 96 changed lines (the claim's estimate was 80–130).

## Readers of the moved lines

These were grepped for the two member names and for the bodies' distinctive text (`readLegacyOrganizationRows(`, `getDriverForObject`):

- the 24 files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`;
- the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and `scripts/`;
- the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads a moved line.**
- **Same names elsewhere, not readers.** `sys-metadata-repository.ts` and `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` each have their own `withoutLegacyOrganizationRows` method on another class. As the claim says, those are not part of this cut.
- **Behaviour, no edit owed.** The doors that read through `findEnvironmentRows` / `findEnvironmentRow` are driven by the package suite, which passes at both ends. `readLegacyOrganizationRows` itself is tested in `metadata-core` (`legacy-organization-row.test.ts`).
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at either member. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). These are `packages/spec/**`, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends.
  - The decision-letter count is unchanged at 1,896.
  - The citation count goes 60,108 → 60,109 and the file count 8,432 → 8,433. That is the new module's header, which names the ADR-0131 ceremony it describes. No moved line cites an ADR.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14005 → 14009, 14030 → 14034).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,819 at base and 3,821 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–28.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `3271a0834c`.

- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).

  - Head `0522e4d4ea`: 21,748 tests (21,722 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 279 files.

- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 96 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `ad684a0ce3`, with no stale-tree finding. All 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21): `findEnvironmentRows`, `findEnvironmentRow`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`, `ensureObjectStorage`, `dropObjectStorage` and `applyRemoteMetadataMutation`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`, and `getOverlayRepo`.
  - `isArtifactBacked`, `isNestedArtifactField` and `packagedArtifactBase` (the `lookupArtifactItem` site pins).
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable` and `resolveSduiManifest`.
